question: women 15-49 literacy decreased between the two rounds - name those districts
gold_sql: SELECT "District" FROM district_health_factsheet WHERE "District" <> 'State Total' GROUP BY "District" HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) < MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) ORDER BY "District"

women 15-49 literacy decreased between the two rounds - name those districts
attempts.response:
WITH literacy AS (
  SELECT
    District,
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) AS lit_4,
    MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) AS lit_5
  FROM district_health_factsheet
  WHERE "Survey Round" IN ('NFHS-4', 'NFHS-5')
  GROUP BY District
)
SELECT
  District,
  lit_4,
  lit_5,
  (lit_5 - lit_4) AS literacy_change
FROM literacy
WHERE lit_5 < lit_4
ORDER BY District;
